relations.subject: Trijang Rinpoche
relations.evidence: The Third Trijang Rinpoche, Lobsang Yeshe Tenzin Gyatso (1901–1981) was a Gelugpa Lama and a direct disciple of Pabongkhapa Déchen Nyingpo.

relations.subject: Trijang Rinpoche
relations.role: junior tutor of the 14th Dalai Lama
relations.evidence: He succeeded Ling Rinpoche as the junior tutor of the 14th Dalai Lama when the Dalai Lama was nineteen years old.

relations.subject: 14th Dalai Lama
relations.evidence: Trijang Rinpoche was the Dalai Lama's teacher until he died. As such, he taught the Dalai Lama from the elementary level up to the highest Tantric transmissions.

relations.subject: 14th Dalai Lama
relations.evidence: These two (Ling Rinpoche and Trijang Rinpoche) remained my tutors until the end of my formal education

relations.subject: Lama Yeshe
relations.evidence: Trijang Rinpoche had many well known disciples, some of whom have become renowned in the West, such as Tenzin Gyatso (the 14th Dalai Lama), Lama Yeshe

relations.subject: Lama Gangchen Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Trijang Rinpoche had many well known disciples, some of whom have become renowned in the West, such as Tenzin Gyatso (the 14th Dalai Lama), Lama Yeshe, Lama Gangchen Rinpoche

relations.subject: Geshe Rabten

relations.subject: Kelsang Gyatso
relations.evidence: Trijang Rinpoche had many well known disciples, some of whom have become renowned in the West, such as Tenzin Gyatso (the 14th Dalai Lama), Lama Yeshe, Lama Gangchen Rinpoche, Geshe Rabten, Lama Zopa Rinpoche and Kelsang Gyatso.

relations.subject: Zong Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He was also a lama of many Gelug lamas who taught in the West including Zong Rinpoche
